items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So Ed Lewis tried it, Al Killian tried it

ctx.x: Yes, yes. He brought it to

Basie, gave it to all four trumpet players before I got it. He started on this end and I happened to be sitting on this end. So Ed Lewis tried it, Al Killian tried it and I don't think it was Harry, somebody else was in there. Anyway, when it got to me, I was the only one that kind of made it like they wanted it. So they, they......
Well that you hadn't done on Basie's records, I mean....
